# CHAROTAR EDUCATION SOCIETY

> Charotar Education Society (CES) is a charitable education society in Anand, Gujarat, India, established in 1916. It runs schools, colleges and hostels.

## Institution

- [About Us](https://cesociety.in/about): Charotar Education Society is an educational organization based in Anand, Gujarat. This page introduces its mission, history, leadership and educational work.
- [Our History](https://cesociety.in/about/history): The history of Charotar Education Society: it grew out of the Petlad Boarding House (1906), was founded in Anand, Gujarat on 16 April 1916, took part in the freedom struggle and marked its centenary in 2015-16 with 100 events and 8 Guinness World Records.
- [CES at a Glance](https://cesociety.in/about/profile): A one-page profile of Charotar Education Society (Anand, Gujarat, founded 1916): 31+ schools, colleges and hostels on three campuses, teaching from pre-primary to Ph.D., with its projects, recognition and contact details.
- [Management](https://cesociety.in/management): The Management page introduces the people who lead Charotar Education Society today. CES has been run by its own volunteers and elected bodies for more than a century.
- [History of VJ Patel](https://cesociety.in/glory/history-vj): The life of Shri Vitthalbhai J. Patel (V.J. Patel): his early life, his part in the freedom movement and his life in teaching. A freedom fighter, teacher and principal, he gave 35 years of his life to Charotar Education Society.
- [Alumni](https://cesociety.in/alumni): Alumni Network is a section of Charotar Education Society (CES), based in Anand, Gujarat. Connect with the Charotar Education Society alumni network, explore alumni initiatives and stay connected with the CES community in Anand, Gujarat.
- [Careers](https://cesociety.in/company/careers): Career Opportunities is a section of Charotar Education Society (CES), based in Anand, Gujarat. Explore career opportunities and recruitment updates from Charotar Education Society. Review current openings and application details published by CES.
- [Job Vacancies](https://cesociety.in/more/career): The Careers page of Charotar Education Society (Anand, Gujarat) lists current vacancies at CES and its institutions, with their application dates, recruitment notices and application forms.
- [Tenders](https://cesociety.in/more/tenders): Tenders and Notices is a section of Charotar Education Society (CES), based in Anand, Gujarat. View tenders, official notices and related announcements published by Charotar Education Society. Check each notice for deadlines and requirements.

## Celebrations

- [Chatkaro](https://cesociety.in/chatkaro): Chatkaro is Charotar Education Society's yearly festival of traditional Gujarati food, with a skill fair and the Alumni Meet, held 11-13 January on the D.N. High School campus in Anand; entry is free.
- [Navratri Mahotsav](https://cesociety.in/navratri): Navratri Festival is a section of Charotar Education Society (CES), based in Anand, Gujarat. Explore Navratri celebrations and cultural activities associated with Charotar Education Society in Anand, Gujarat. Check the latest announcements for event details.
- [Centenary Celebration](https://cesociety.in/celebration): Celebration is a section of Charotar Education Society (CES), based in Anand, Gujarat. Discover celebrations, cultural programmes and special events organized by Charotar Education Society and its educational institutions.
